Courses for teachers and education staff

Scheduled one- and two-week courses in Barcelona for teachers, trainers, school leaders and support staff, from primary to university and VET. You join an international group.

See the dates Ask about a week

Barcelona course fee

  • €40020 hours a week
  • €45025 hours a week

Per person, per week. Course materials and the week's two cultural activities are included.

What the fee does not cover

Travel, accommodation and meals are not part of the fee. Under Erasmus+ they come from the grant's own budget lines.

Fees for the other Spanish destinations are published on SpainBcn ↗.

How a course week works

  • FormatOne week, or two. Two-week courses run to 50 hours.
  • HoursYou choose 20 or 25 hours a week when you book, and the fee follows it.
  • TimetableClasses run Monday to Friday mornings. Two afternoons are given to the week's cultural activities. Both are included in the fee, both are optional, and someone from the team goes with the group.
  • GroupSmall international groups. Participants usually come from several European countries in the same week.
  • MaterialsCourse materials are handed out on the first day, matched to the levels in the room.
  • CertificateCertificate of attendance. Issued on the final day of the course.
